payload.title: frick CLI parity: verify / backup / restore + inspect diagnostics
payload.description: These frick CLI subcommands return cli.unsupported after the cutover: verify (was pnpm verify:generated), backup/restore (need dumpFrickDatabase/restoreFrickDatabase Rust counterparts), and inspect diagnostics (assembleDiagnosticsSnapshot, FR-76/FR-77, unported). They are listed in --help for surface parity. Port the underlying capabilities in frick-store/frick-server and wire the commands.
